regime_context: China A-shares show an extreme one-narrative regime: Banks (rank 1, score 1.078, eligible, durability_bar 0.83, breadth 1.0, crowded) dominate with Coal (rank 2, 1.038, eligible, mean-revert, not crowded) as the only other eligible theme. Only 2 of 22 themes are eligible (frac 0.09), and the backtest verdict is explicit that the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history — so this is mean-reverting, display-only context, and conviction must be low given the track record's 33.7% directional accuracy.
emerging_watch: Watch whether SOE Blue Chips (durability_bar 0.58, breadth 0.688, crowded) becomes eligible — the observable condition would be it crossing the absolute-trend eligibility threshold while Banks' crowd flag persists; only a confirmed eligibility plus coherent breadth would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the sole dominant eligible theme (durability_bar 0.83, breadth 1.0, crowding_z 1.85) but the crowding flag is a sizing caution, not a fade. With the trend gate shown not to reduce drawdown on this mean-reverting tape and rank-IC ~0, there is no validated edge to favor the leader; the honest lean is to not overweight what the detector cannot substantiate as directional.
theses.dissent: Banks may continue to lead simply because they are the only high-breadth, high-durability trend in an otherwise mean-reverting tape; underweighting the sole leader could leave exposure tilted toward weaker themes.

falsifier.text: Banks (512800.SS) outperforms CSI 300 by 3% or more over any rolling 10-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only other eligible theme and ranks second, but its durability_bar is only 0.55 with hurst_tag mean-revert and breadth 0.5 — a weak, half-formed trend the gate flags as mean-reverting. With no drawdown-control edge on this market and dir_accuracy 0.337, an avoid lean is the most defensible expression of not trusting the detector's attention signal as alpha.
theses.dissent: Coal is the only eligible challenger with non-trivial breadth; if Banks consolidate, Coal could catch a growth/value rotation bid without being crowded.

falsifier.text: Coal (515220.SS) lags Banks (512800.SS) by 2% or less over the next 15 trading days while both remain eligible

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
